Container.Name: ShardsOfAshen
Container.Overview: Shards of Ashen: a top-down pixel-art RPG for up to five players sharing one world, played through the Shards of Ashen app, or the website for a public server. You are the true heir of Ashen. There's nothing to open at this server's own address.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The port the game answers on: forward it on your router, or put a reverse proxy in front

Config.Name: Game data
Config.Description: Accounts, characters, the world and daily backups

Config.Name: Max players
Config.Description: How many can play at once

Config.Name: New characters
Config.Description: open: anyone who can reach the server can make a character. closed: only accounts made with tools/admin.py

Config.Name: Invite code
Config.Description: If set, making a character needs this code

Config.Name: Admins
Config.Description: Hallisium accounts whose characters get the Admin button, comma-separated (e.g. Kris,Ann): the central server proves them. Without one, use tools/admin.py admin Name on.

Config.Name: Central server
Config.Description: The central server: this is a remote server, listed there once it's approved on its admin page, and players sign in by their Hallisium accounts, from anywhere

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The address players outside your network use, e.g. https://play.example.com. Blank: the address it calls the central server from, on port 8484

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: What players see this server called: in the start screen's Public servers list (up to 40 letters), on its login screen and in the Android app's list of games on the network. Changing it takes a listed server off the list till it's approved again. An admin's name in the game's Options wins over this one.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: 1 if players come through a reverse proxy on your network (Caddy, Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG), so those on your own network still count as on it. Without it, anyone coming through the proxy needs a Hallisium account

Config.Name: Backup copy
Config.Description: Another folder for a copy of each day's backup, on a different disk from appdata or another machine (e.g. a share on the array, /mnt/user/backups/shards-of-ashen, or one mounted from another PC): a dead cache disk then doesn't take the backups with it. Blank: none

Config.Name: Backup bucket
Config.Description: Each day's backup off the machine, to a bucket at an S3-style store: https://endpoint/bucket, e.g. https://s3.us-west-004.backblazeb2.com/my-backups (Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, Amazon S3). Give it a key that can write but not delete, and a lifecycle rule to clear old copies: README-Server.md, Backups off the machine. Blank: none

Config.Name: Backup bucket region
Config.Description: Only if the endpoint's name doesn't say it (blank: from the name, else us-east-1)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user the game runs as (Unraid: 99, nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group the game runs as (Unraid: 100, users)
